text:
kevin: Holding the release window. Staging promote failing: deploy-bot reports digest mismatch for container image layers served from registry replica. Looks like a replica drift.
zoe: Paste the deploy-bot log?
kevin: deploy-bot excerpt:
```
[deploy-bot] GET https://registry.prod.internal/v2/app/manifests/release-2026-03-21 -> 200
[deploy-bot] fetched manifest mediaType=application/vnd.oci.image.manifest.v1+json
[deploy-bot] pulling layer sha256:abc123 size=12,204,800 -> OK
[deploy-bot] computed manifest digest != expected (expected=sha256:fff111..., got=sha256:001122...)
[deploy-bot] integrity-check failed, aborting promote
```
deploy-bot: promote blocked (integrity-check-failure). Auto-promote suspended for R-2026-03-21-6.
ci-bot: noted: manifest-digest-flip detected across registry replicas (count=2/4 replicas inconsistent).
infra: We rolled out a registry node yesterday with different compression settings; looks like some replicas serve blobs compressed with zstd v1.4 vs v1.5 which changes digest. Investigating.
zoe: Oof. That means images pushed earlier may compute different manifest digest depending on which replica you hit. Risky to force-promote.
release-manager: Agreed - pin to last-known-good digest (sha256:77cafe) and suspend auto-promote until we can restore replica consistency. Need a short customer blurb.
kevin: OK doing: `/deploybot suspend R-2026-03-21-6` -> done. Routing flipped to sha256:77cafe for 60m. Drafting announcement: "Delay: registry replica drift caused manifest digest mismatch; pinned previous image while we fix registry; manual promote pending verification; ETA 30-60m."
infra: We're running a sync job to recompute and reconcile manifests across replicas. ETA ~20m. We'll also temporarily disable zstd v1.5 on the new node.
zoe: Can infra push a re-push of the image manifest (retag) after consistency is restored and provide a canonical digest to promote?
infra: Yes, plan: re-push manifest from a verified replica, update registry indexes, then CDN purge. We'll provide the canonical digest.
ci-bot: preflight check suggestion: add registry-replica-consistency check before promote and fail fast if replicas disagree. Filing ticket PLAT-1500.
release-manager: Good. Who's owner for release notes and external comms? I'll take it once we confirm the canonical digest.
kevin: Action list: infra reconcile registry (in progress), ci-bot add preflight check (PLAT-1500), release-manager draft comms. Keep deploy-bot suspended. Zoe, monitor smoke tests on pinned digest.
zoe: Smoke tests running now on sha256:77cafe -> all green so far. Monitoring metrics.
infra: Registry reconcile done. Canonical manifest digest computed: sha256:fff111... (matches expected). Pushed canonical manifest and invalidated CDN keys for tags `release-2026-03-21`.
deploy-bot: artifact fetch retries now return consistent manifest digest sha256:fff111.... Pre-promote smoke run queued.
zoe: Running quick integration suite against canonical image.
ci-bot: integration run passed.
release-manager: Approving manual promote. Please run `/deploybot promote --manual R-2026-03-21-6` when ready.
kevin: Executing manual promote. Rolling update policy: 5% -> 25% -> 100% with health checks.
deploy-bot: manual promote accepted. Rolling update started.
release-manager: Posting release note to #release-announcements: "Short delay due to registry replica compression mismatch causing manifest digest inconsistency; pinned previous image during reconciliation; manual promote completed after registry reconcile and verification; rollout resumed. Follow-ups: PLAT-1500 (preflight), PLAT-1501 (registry compression rollback guard)."
zoe: Monitoring metrics, no regressions so far. Thanks infra for the fast reconcile.
kevin: Closing hold once rollout hits 100%. Great job team. :white_check_mark:
